review_type: Retrospective review; the initial mobile pass skipped ImageGen

iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. OpenFA Braccatian WidowMaker BR1C large combat ship, retrospective ImageGen concept iteration1 of max3. Input is actual paletted legacy headings, authoritative shape and broad color fields. Preserve a stout tapered ochre/gold barrel-like main pressure body, rose-copper rounded/narrowed end cap, dark slate-grey longitudinal side cheek structures and small thin projecting grey fins. Opposite the copper end, a broad cut-off aft face has FOUR distinct dark circular recessed openings arranged around its axis as visible in legacy. Render those as openings with collars, do not assert whether engines or weapons; no flames or gun barrels. The legacy end-on views constrain their count and the rounded gold outer hull. Subtle rose surface accents near the narrower end. Keep the craft compact and broad like the source rather than a long human jet, no cockpit canopy, extra guns, missiles, external pods or insignia. Worn brass/ochre metal, rose copper, slate cheeks and silver rims; small joint grime, scratches and sparse mechanical seams, no dense hull panel grid. One clear three-quarter view plus smaller reverse/aft view of the SAME craft showing the four openings, neutral dark studio backdrop, no text and no original pixel collage.
iterations.verdict: Retained for stout tapered ochre hull, copper endcap, slate longitudinal cheeks, thin fins and four aft openings; inset/hero agree.

glb_visual_review: Imported GLB retains the tapered ochre body, broad copper terminal, slate cheeks/fins and four recessed aft openings. Small structural seams differ because legacy does not resolve exact engineering. Rougher alloy finish follows concept feedback without changing primary geometry.
